info.title: MFSN-REPORTS
info.description:
Specification for the MFSN 2.0 production authentication and 3B report APIs.
This spec is derived from the Postman collection "MFSN 2.0 - PRODUCTION-Fetch 3B"
and the observed request/response samples in Postman.

post.description:
Authenticates a user and returns access/session tokens that are then used in subsequent calls such as
`/api/auth/fetch-3B-json` and `/api/auth/logout`.

Fetches a three-bureau (3B) credit report for a logged-in member.

The request in Postman uses `multipart/form-data` with:
- `email`: member email (typically `{{email_mem}}`)
- `client_token`: client authorization token

The response is a large nested JSON structure that includes provider views,
scores, accounts, inquiries, and more. The schema below focuses on the
top-level structure and key nested objects; it can be extended as needed.

scoreReasons.description: The date that you opened your oldest account...

value.message: The email field must be a valid email address.
Access token is required. Please login.
Invalid or expired access token. Please login again.
The client token field is required.

post.description:
Logs out the currently authenticated user and invalidates the session
associated with the provided tokens.

unauthorized.summary: Not logged in or invalid tokens

bankruptcies.description: : A proceeding in federal court whereby a person who is unable to pay his debts in full may be discharged from the legal obligation to do so. Three types apply to consumers: 1. Chapter 7 refers to a court proceeding where one's unprotected assets are sold and disbursed to pay creditors. 2. Chapter 13 allows the debtor an extended time to repay all or part of his/her debts. The debtor is allowed to keep his/her assets. 3. Chapter 12 refers to a court proceeding where financial obligations are released due to the inability of a family farm to pay their debts. _Optional_

judgments.description: : A determination by a court of law that, in the case of credit, may require a person to fulfill an obligation-to pay a debt, for example. When a judgement has been satisfied (i.e, the debit has been paid or settled), the consumer has fulfilled their requirements and is no longer liable. Information about judgments is recorded in the public records section of a credit report. _Optional_

liens.description: : A legal claim upon the property of another as security to ensure that a debt will be paid. A tax lien is a lien filed by a state government or by the Federal government. The Federal Government's Internal Revenue Service, which collects income taxes from consumers may place notices of liens in county courts, listing the consumer's unpaid federal income taxes. Lien Released - Means that the lien is paid. _Optional_
